notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
description:
Cast Three Steps Ahead by paying {U} plus an additional {3} to select its second mode, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Three Steps Ahead, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Three Steps Ahead, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
